items.summary: Fix the backend `startUpload` function so that it correctly identifies authenticated callers. The current access control check is rejecting legitimate upload requests with 'Unauthorized: Only users can start uploads'. Inspect the caller identity check in the `startUpload` handler — ensure it accepts any non-anonymous principal (i.e., a real Internet Identity user) rather than applying an overly restrictive check such as comparing against a hardcoded admin principal or using a broken identity comparison. The fix must allow authenticated Internet Identity users to call `startUpload`, `uploadChunk`, and `finalizeUpload` successfully.

Verify that the frontend actor in `useActor.ts` / `useQueries.ts` is constructed with the authenticated identity (not anonymous) when the user is logged in via Internet Identity before calling `startUpload`. If the actor is being created anonymously even when the user is authenticated, ensure it is rebuilt with the correct identity so the backend receives a non-anonymous principal.
